caption: The drawing features a single object: a symmetrical, two-handled cup set against a plain, off-white background. The cup has a broad, gently rounded body that tapers slightly towards a flat, horizontal base. Each side of the cup is adorned with an ornate, curved handle that extends upwards and outwards, ending in decorative curls. The handles are mirror images of each other. On the upper right side of the cup's body, there is a small inscription or marking that reads "F.G." In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name “Lawrence Flynn” is handwritten in cursive. The entire composition is executed in clean, thin black lines with no shading, color, or additional embellishments.
title: Silver Caudle Cup
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
